name: TO-ACT
fullName: Endovascular Treatment With Medical Management vs Standard Care in Severe Cerebral Venous Thrombosis
population: n=67, adults, NIHSS severe CVT with >=1 risk factor for poor outcome, EVT within 24 h of randomization; 12-month outcome
finding: No benefit — HALTED after the first interim analysis for futility
teachingPoint: Endovascular therapy for severe CVT showed no benefit and was halted for futility — anticoagulation remains first-line.

name: ACTION-CVT
fullName: Direct Oral Anticoagulants Versus Warfarin in the Treatment of Cerebral Venous Thrombosis
population: n=845, mean 44.8; 64.7% women, NIHSS CVT on oral anticoagulation, treated Jan 2015 - Dec 2020; median follow-up 345 d
finding: Similar recurrence: aHR 0.94 (95% CI 0.51-1.73); major hemorrhage LOWER with DOACs: aHR 0.35 (0.15-0.82, p=0.02)
teachingPoint: DOACs perform like warfarin for CVT recurrence and recanalization with less major bleeding — a reasonable first-line option.
